rows.quote: To further validate the findings, an external dataset consisting of plasma pQTL data from the deCODE cohort, as reported by Ferkingstad et al, was utilized.16 This dataset encompassed measurements of 4907 plasma proteins in a large cohort of 35,559 participants.
rows.reference_quote: Ferkingstad E, Sulem P, Atlason BA, et al. Large-scale integration of the plasma proteome with genetics and disease. Nat Genet . 2021;53:1712–1721. doi: 10.1038/s41588-021-00978-w
rows.coder_note: Sentence attributes the external pQTL dataset to the deCODE cohort as reported by Ferkingstad et al with citation 16 and gives 35,559 participants; the entry DOI is the Ferkingstad 2021 row source only.
